description: Source: HyperTracker. Read-only whole-exchange Hyperliquid cohorts by size and PnL, liquidation risk, wallet profiles, closed trades and biggest positions. Requires the user's HYPERTRACKER_API_TOKEN. API requests: health/freshness 1; closedTrades/biggestPositions 2; other operations 3. Auxiliary status and segment reads count against the user's paid plan; cost is not estimated. State redirects may add an S3 download. Hosted disabled by default. Snapshot age is labelled; main state refreshes about every 31 minutes. No exchange-wide fills or order downloads.

address.description: Required for walletProfile/closedTrades, rejected for other operations; exact wallet only.

coin.description: Required for cohortPositioning/cohortHistory; optional page filter for liquidationRisk, closedTrades and biggestPositions. Rejected for other operations. Exact ticker such as BTC or kPEPE, optional DEX prefix such as xyz:SP500. Heatmap filtered client-side.

limit.description: Page size for cohortHistory, liquidationRisk, closedTrades and biggestPositions only.

nextCursor.description: cohortHistory and closedTrades only; unavailable pages retain continuation context.

segmentId.description: Required for cohortHistory/liquidationRisk; optional for cohortPositioning/cohortSummary, rejected for other operations. Definitions are read from upstream.

start.description: Required for cohortHistory only, UTC ISO 8601.

startTime.description: Closed trades UTC ISO 8601; defaults to upstream seven-day window.

name: hypertracker
